investigation_notes.Description: An unusual volume of SharePoint file downloads (920) was observed from Jonas.Laitis@globalcorp.ee, far above the 24-hour baseline of 10 files. The downloads target a SharePoint Online site and include a mix of documents, with the user located in Vilnius, Lithuania. The combination of a very high data volume, bulk access to potentially sensitive documents, and the remote location relative to typical business hours supports classifying this as High Priority.
